claim: In the Custom event buses - classic pricing example, where custom events published to an event bus in Account A are sent to another event bus in Account B and then to another service in Account B, custom events delivered to another event bus are charged at $1.00/M, and custom events delivered to a service in the same account are charged at $0.00/M.

qualifiers.scope: Custom event buses - classic; per M (million) custom events delivered, events of 64 KB or less
qualifiers.condition: Worked example: Account A bus to Account B bus, then to a service in Account B.

evidence.quote: If you publish 10 million of your own events to an event bus in Account A in one month, send 5 million of those events to another event bus in Account B, and then send those events to another service in Account B, your charges would be calculated as follows:

Monthly custom events delivered to another event bus = 5M events (all equal to or less than 64 KB each) Monthly custom events delivered to a service in the same account = 5M events (all equal to or less than 64KB each) Monthly delivery charge = (5M * $1.00/M) + (5M * $0.00/M) = $5.00 per month
